settingsAccountsSummary: {count, plural, =0{No accounts yet} =1{1 account} other{{count} accounts}}
settingsRuleHint: How much of net income should go into each bucket. 50/30/20 is a common choice.
settingsLockSubtitle: Unlock with fingerprint or device PIN; hide content in recent apps and screenshots
settingsLockNoDeviceLock: Set up a screen lock on your device first.
settingsLockLockedText: Unlock the app to see your numbers.
settingsPrivacyText: All data is stored encrypted inside the app on this device (SQLCipher compatible, key in the Android Keystore). The app has no internet permission, is excluded from Android backups and sends nothing anywhere. Data only leaves the device via a password-protected backup you create yourself.
settingsKeyUnavailableText: The key for your encrypted data could not be read right now. Your data is unchanged — please try again in a moment.
settingsUnreadableText: Your stored data could not be decrypted (e.g. after resetting device security) and was set aside. Restore it from a backup.
householdRemoveText: Their income and accounts are archived. Their items remain and count as shared afterwards.
accountsIntro: Accounts are the targets in the split view: current accounts, savings sub-accounts for holidays or gifts, cards. A person's main account receives what is left.
accountsMainHint: Receives the money left to spend
accountsBalanceHint: For emergency fund and savings projection
categoriesIntro: Categories group your items. The bucket decides how they count in the budget rule.
categoriesNotEmpty: Only empty categories can be deleted.
backupIntro: Encrypted file with all data (AES-256). It cannot be opened without the password — keep it safe.
backupRestoreConfirmText: The backup replaces all current data in the app. This cannot be undone.
backupPassphraseCreateHint: The backup is encrypted with this password. It is not stored anywhere.
backupWrongApp: This file is not a Mai Budget backup.
backupTooNew: The backup comes from a newer app version — please update the app first.
backupUnsupported: Backups are not available in this version.
